scope: Default-mode inference over bounded snippets from an operator-imported corpus, using an operator-configured endpoint; no training or new source discovery.
default: New API/browser requests default to llm and reject before acceptance when no model is configured. Explicit ranking=lexical performs no model call. Existing accepted jobs are unchanged; legacy lexical clients/replays must send the mode explicitly after upgrading.
rights: Operator must review corpus rights and permission to process excerpts with the selected runtime/provider. Ingestion, a gateway account or a licence string is not a blanket permission grant.
retention: Anvesha retains operational jobs/snapshots/feedback under its documented local policy, but does not persist model prompts, raw responses or reasoning. Runtime/gateway/provider retention is outside Anvesha's control.
privacy: Loopback restricts Anvesha's destination, not gateway egress. Do not claim local inference or untracked search without verifying downstream routing and logs.
training: No automatic training in Anvesha; separately review any downstream provider's training policy.
licensing: Independently implemented Apache-2.0 client. No OmniRoute code or model weights are distributed; gateway, model and document licences remain separate.
candidate_aliases: Short per-request aliases map back only to supplied result objects. They are not authorization or anonymization. Original public result IDs and source rights remain stable.
output_format: json_object remains the compatibility default. Optional operator-configured json_schema requests bounded known aliases and exact array length. Client validation still rejects omissions/duplicates. No implicit format or provider fallback; the accepted fingerprint includes the format.
